title: Push and reusable workflow runner-context registration repair

phases.objective: Restore GitHub Actions registration for the ten workflows that failed before runner allocation.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions planner and repository governance reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Static workflow definitions and the focused registration regression
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every affected workflow can be planned without evaluating runner.temp in job-level environment context.
steps: Require a bounded post-allocation RUNNER_TEMP initialization or stable repository-relative artifact path.
assertions: No affected workflow evaluates runner.temp in jobs.<job>.env.
Existing triggers, immutable bindings, permissions, and authorization gates remain unchanged.
No provider, deployment, migration, database, or Production action is executed by the regression.

phases.objective: Preserve bounded evidence paths and all existing exact trigger and authorization boundaries.
Fail closed if job-level runner.temp is reintroduced in any affected workflow.
No provider or Production canary is authorized by this registration-only repair.
This repair performs no Production action or deployment.
